name: Beasties
description: Shaggy, horned creatures born of cocoons in the House whose purpose is to befriend and protect keep-alives.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: An elder beastie prepares a newly grown young beastie to learn its purpose.
timeline.quote: You are ready, child-no-longer, to understand your purpose here.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The first beasties emerge from their cocoons into the House with no sense of purpose.
timeline.quote: When the first of us emerged from our cocoons into the splendid horror of House, we wandered with no comprehension of our purpose.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Spindlewight, the pack's first leader, leaves to find the beasties' purpose.
timeline.quote: he left us, left his pack and his kin, to walk the body of House

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Without Spindlewight the beasties split into the packs they have today and declare the mural neutral ground.
timeline.quote: we broke into the packs we occupy today

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The elder sends the young beastie to make a mask and find its own keep-alive.
timeline.quote: Fashion a mask from these things we have gathered

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

relations.note: Their leader at the very beginning.
relations.quote: our leader, all the way back then in the very beginning, was a great and terrible beastie who called himself Spindlewight

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

relations.note: Beasties describe themselves as born of the House.
relations.quote: Born we are of House, as all good things must be born of House

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.
